title: The Fed - Supervisory Letter SR 16-3 on Interagency Guidance on Funds Transfer Pricing Related to Funding and Contingent Liquidity Risks -- February 29, 2016
主要内容: The Federal Reserve issued Supervisory Letter SR 16-3 on February 29, 2016, providing interagency guidance on funds transfer pricing (FTP) related to funding and contingent liquidity risks. This guidance targets large financial institutions, including domestic bank holding companies, savings and loan holding companies, and state member banks with consolidated assets of $250 billion or more, or foreign exposure of $10 billion or more. The guidance aims to address weaknesses in FTP practices, particularly in managing funding risk and contingent liquidity risk. It builds on the principles outlined in SR letter 10-6 and incorporates elements from the Basel Committee's international statement on sound liquidity risk management. FTP is crucial for managing a firm's balance sheet structure and measuring risk-adjusted profitability. Effective FTP aligns business lines' risk-taking incentives with the firm's risk appetite, promoting resilient and sustainable business models. Conversely, poor FTP implementation can lead to misallocation of financial resources and undermine the business model. The guidance emphasizes the importance of developing, implementing, and maintaining an effective FTP framework to ensure proper risk management.
